landing.hero.title:
Platform baako ma wo
asɔre abusua nyinaa
landing.hero.subtitle: Hwɛ nnipa so, di attendance ho akontaa wɔ nnwom ahorow mu, kyerɛw ntotoo ne afɔrebɔ, mena SMS nkra, na di wo nguan akyi wɔ system baako a ɛyɛ mmerɛw mu.
landing.problems.label: Nsɛmmɔne
landing.problems.title: Wonim eyi?
landing.problems.subtitle: Asɔre pii nya ɔhaw wɔ akwan a ɛnte bɔ mu a ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ wobehu na woasom wo asafo no papa.
landing.problems.scattered_text: Nhoma, spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups — nnipa nsɛm wɔ baabiara gye baabi a wohia no.
landing.problems.attendance_text: Nnwom ahorow, anadwo nhyiam, ne programs soronko — nanso wonnim nea ɔba biara.
landing.problems.giving_text: Ntotoo ne afɔrebɔ a wɔboaboa ano wɔ nsa so a transparency nsua, na ɛma accountability yɛ den.
landing.problems.followup_text: Nnipa foforo, wɔn a wɔmba, ne wɔn a wɔhia mmoa fi mu kɔ a system biara nni hɔ mma pastoral care.
landing.features.label: Modules titiriw
landing.features.title: Biribiara a wo asɔre hia
landing.features.subtitle: Modules asia a ɛyɛ adwuma bɔ mu de boa wo asɔre kɔ so yiye na ɛhwɛ ɔpata biara so.
landing.features.members_text: Nnipa profile a edi mu wɔ abusua nkitaho, nkitaho nsɛm, ɔsom mu ne profile a nnipa foforo betumi awie.
landing.features.attendance_text: Kyerɛw attendance ma Kwasiada nnwom (1st, 2nd, 3rd), anadwo nhyiam, ne programs soronko.
landing.features.giving_text: Kyerɛw sika biara a wɔde ba — ntotoo, afɔrebɔ, bɔhyɛ, ne aba soronko. Nnipa betumi ahu wɔn sika ho nsɛm.
landing.features.comms_text: SMS a wɔde mena nnipa pii, nkra a wɔde kɔ kuw ne department, awoda nkyea, ne push notifications.
landing.features.pastoral_text: Hyɛ nnipa agyirae ma follow-up, di nsrahwɛ akontaa, kyerɛw counselling nsɛm na hwɛ sɛ obiara nka fie.
landing.features.reporting_text: Yɛ attendance, sika, ne ɔnyamesom mu nkɔso reports. Audit trails ma biribiara da adi.
landing.roles.label: Wɔyɛɛ ma obiara
landing.roles.title: Hwan na ChurchOS yɛ ma no?
landing.roles.subtitle: Dwumadie anum a ɛsono biara wɔ ne dashboard ne access level.
landing.roles.admin_desc: System nyinaa so tumi — hwɛ users so, yɛ settings, na hwɛ asɔre adwuma nyinaa so.
landing.roles.pastor_desc: Asɔre apɔmuden nhwehwɛmu — attendance trends, sika patterns, ne nnipa a wɔahyɛ agyirae.
landing.roles.leader_desc: Hwɛ wo department roster so, kyerɛw attendance, na di follow-ups akontaa.
landing.roles.finance_desc: Kyerɛw sika, yɛ sika reports, na hwɛ accountability so.
landing.roles.member_desc: Hwɛ wo profile, di wo attendance akontaa, hwɛ wo sika nsɛm, na tena nkra so.
landing.cta.title: Woasiesie wo ho sɛ wode wo asɔre bɛbɔ mu?
landing.cta.subtitle: Bɛka Ghana asɔredan ɔha ahorow a wɔde ChurchOS di dwuma de hwɛ wɔn asafo so ho.
